title: Introduce incremental presubmit lint cache and idempotent toolchain bootstrap
author: Lena Mueller
release_notes: Improves presubmit latency and reliability by adding an incremental lint cache and making the toolchain bootstrap idempotent; reduces CI wall-clock time for small changes.
description:
Context and motivation: Our presubmit lanes have grown costly and noisy: lint shards re-run the full toolchain bootstrap and re-download SDK artifacts even for trivial changes, and several teams have hit nondeterministic failures caused by partial bootstrap state. This PR introduces two coordinated improvements: (1) an incremental lint cache that keys on staged file fingerprint + lockfile fingerprint to skip unaffected lint shards, and (2) an idempotent toolchain bootstrap process (tiny microimage + deterministic install paths) so retries and parallel presubmit runners converge to identical state. Goals: faster feedback for small edits, fewer flaky premerge failures, less egress from CI, and clearer cache invalidation semantics.

What changed (high level):
- New lightweight cache layer: tools/presubmit/lint-cache/ with a content-addressed metadata index and eviction policy tuned for presubmit lifetimes.
- Deterministic bootstrap: scripts/bootstrap.go reworked to install toolchain under /opt/redwood-toolchain/<lockfile-hash>, uses package digests rather than timestamps.
- CI integration: .github/workflows/presubmit.yml updated with cache warm/restore steps and a new 'lint-fast' job that consults the lint-cache before running full linters.
- Tooling: docker/mini-toolchain.Dockerfile adds a microimage used for presubmit; Makefile targets for bootstrapping added.
- Docs: docs/dev/presubmit.md documents cache keys, invalidation, and how to run locally.

Single-line checklist:
- [x] Implement cache and bootstrap changes
- [x] Update presubmit workflow and tests
- [x] Add doc for local reproduction
- [x] Smoke-run presubmit in staging

Commit summary (high level):
- feat(presubmit): add incremental lint cache and index
- refactor(bootstrap): make toolchain bootstrap idempotent by hashing lockfile
- ci(presubmit): consult lint cache and add microimage restore steps
- test: add unit tests for cache key derivation and bootstrap path resolution
- docs: presubmit.md and quickstart for local dev

Changed areas and illustrative snippets (not a full diff):
- .github/workflows/presubmit.yml (added lint-fast job and cache steps)
- tools/presubmit/lint-cache/cache.go (content-addressed index API + eviction)
- scripts/bootstrap.go (now computes lockfile hash, installs to stable path)
- docker/mini-toolchain.Dockerfile (base image + pinned pkg hashes)
- Makefile (bootstrap-target, presubmit-local)
- docs/dev/presubmit.md (usage and troubleshooting)

Review conversation (summary):
- Marcus Patel (reviewer): "What's the invalidation story when the lockfile changes vs when only unrelated files are edited? Are we at risk of serving stale lint results?" Author reply: "Cache key is a two-tuple: staged-files-fingerprint + lockfile-hash. When the lockfile changes, the key changes and cached results are not used. We also added a TTL (48h) so long-lived branches don't grow cache cruft. See tools/presubmit/lint-cache/README in this PR for details." Marcus: "Please add an explicit unit test for lockfile-change invalidation." Author: "Added unit test commit 'test(presubmit): lockfile invalidation unit test'."

- Arielle Chen (reviewer, approver): "Bootstrap looks good, but can the new install path collide on self-hosted runners?" Author reply: "We compute a lockfile-hash-based path and use file-system level advisory locks during install. For self-hosted runners admins can opt out by setting REDWOOD_TOOLCHAIN_DIR; docs updated." Arielle: "Add a short troubleshooting section; otherwise LGTM." Author: "Added troubleshooting and a note about REDWOOD_TOOLCHAIN_DIR."

- Diego Alvarez: "Would like lightweight telemetry when fallback to full lint occurs (cache miss)." Author: "Added a small counter metric emitted to the existing presubmit telemetry bucket; instrumented in cache.go and presubmit workflow to surface in Console."

CI status and iteration notes:
- Initial CI run: lint-fast job skipped incorrectly for rust files, caused by a glob mismatch; fixed in commit 'ci: fix lint glob for rust' -> rerun.
- Second run: unit tests passed, integration presubmit smoke had a flaky network test (CI-INT-007) failing; test retried and passed on rerun.
- Final run: all checks green: lint-fast, unit, integration-smoke, presubmit-e2e.

Testing performed:
- Unit tests for cache logic on Linux and macOS runners (GH Actions matrix)
- Staging presubmit run across the redwood monorepo to measure wall-clock improvement: median presubmit latency for small edits dropped from ~4m20s to ~1m45s.
- Verified idempotent bootstrap by running two parallel bootstrap jobs and ensuring identical /opt/redwood-toolchain/<hash> contents (deterministic package digests asserted).

Follow-ups and caveats:
- This does not yet cover the large python/third-party wheel caching optimization; that's tracked in ENG-2310 and will follow.
- Cache TTL and eviction heuristics are conservative; we'll monitor in the Console and iterate.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged by Arielle Chen. Squash commit message: "presubmit: incremental lint cache + idempotent toolchain bootstrap (ENG-2143)". Back-ported none. Release notes: added in release changelog under CI improvements.

Links:
- Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2143

If anything breaks, revert guidance: revert the squash commit or set PRESUBMIT_LINT_CACHE=0 in CI to short-circuit the cache and fall back to baseline behavior.
notes: Performance: median presubmit latency for tiny edits reduced ~60% in staging
Operational: introduces a short TTL for cache items to avoid long-lived stale entries
